identity.description: An attacker initiates an RDP session from a managed host to a remote target, potentially leveraging stolen credentials or compromised accounts. Cortex should detect this behavior as an anomalous RDP session originating from a managed host. The attack includes establishing the RDP connection and executing commands via the session.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon RDP Session from Managed Host
biocs.description: Detection of an RDP session initiated from a managed host to a remote target, which is not typical behavior for managed systems.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = '/tmp/rdp_client'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 3389
